basis: the decisive gate requires external resources that are not present on this machine and cannot be fabricated locally; per the completion rules, unavailable comparator/user/external evidence remains unmeasured and nothing was silently substituted
blockers: requires a direct connection to the user's own AI provider account — no provider credentials are available to the agent
the evaluation battery requires unseen-task grading including independent domain assessment by a human evaluator
unblocks_when: the named external resources become available; the phase then opens with its own protocol and frozen gate evidence
